notes: NEW STATE. Cliopatria has no row for this province; Later Mayan City-States (1429-1546, 135,136 to 187,745 km2) covers the whole northern lowlands and contains it. The Kuchkabal page says the extent of the provinces 'is still debated' and that scholars disagree 'on whether they were territorial units or jurisdictions'; the shape here is a disc around the capital, soft, and no frontier is claimed. Cliopatria keeps its envelope to 1546 although the Spanish took the provinces one by one from 1527. CHAKAN. Not the same as Chakán Putum (Champotón, a separate dossier). The 1542 loss at Mérida is the conquest page's town council date applied to Ti'ho; the identification Ti'ho = Mérida is the gazetteer's alias, not the pages'. Batabs named: Ah Kin Euán of Caucel and Ah Kin Chuy (no dates).
